title: Forensic Factor
source_summary: Historical case reference | Wikipedia article extract: Forensic Factor is a Canadian true crime docuseries, which airs on Discovery Channel Canada, Sun TV, and the True Crime Network. The series, which uses an anthology format, features forensic techniques and their application in crime-solving by examining notable cases.
